items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: And Roy Palmer was on trombone with us.

ctx.x: Did he want some? Ask him if he wants some. You want some? Yeah, I'll make water. I'll get that.

He wants you to ask you did you ever work with Roy Palmer? Who did I work? Did you ever work with Roy Palmer? No, my baddie. My oldest brother. Yeah. Which brother was daddy? I wasn't good enough. Which brother was daddy? He said. Brother St. John. St. John. Yeah. I don't think we know them friends. Daddy wasn't coming out. He died. Yeah. He was 29 years old when he died.
